SELECT DISTINCT TABLE_ID , TABLE_NAME FROM BOK_TABLELIST WHERE 1 = 1
and ( TABLE_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{likeStr},'%') or TABLE_NAME like concat_ws('','%',#{likeStr},'%') )
order by TABLE_ID

SELECT B.VAL_DATE AS valDate,B.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId,B.FINPROD_NAME AS finprodName, SUM(B.CAPITAL�? AS CAPITAL,SUM(B.ASSET_VALUE) AS assetValue,SUM(B.NET_UNIT_VALUE�? AS netUnitValue,
SUM(B.TAOTALNETVALUE) AS totalNetValue,SUM(B.SEVENDAYRATE) AS sevenDayRate,SUM(B.PAYPROFIT) AS payProfit FROM ( SELECT A.VAL_DATE AS VAL_DATE,A.FINPROD_ID AS FINPROD_ID,A.FINPROD_NAME AS FINPROD_NAME, CASE WHEN A.DETAIL_DIST = '01' AND SUBJECT_NO = '22320101' THEN (case when A.BAL_FLAG = 'C' then 1 else -1 end) *A.COST ELSE 0 END AS PAYPROFIT, CASE WHEN A.DETAIL_DIST = '02' THEN A.COST ELSE 0 END AS CAPITAL,
(case when A.PROFIT_TYPE = '01' then (case when A.DETAIL_DIST = '07' then A.MARKET_VALUE else 0 end) when A.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' then (case when A.DETAIL_DIST = '28' then CAST( A.SUBJECT_NAME ) else 0 end) else 0 end) ASSET_VALUE,
(case when A.PROFIT_TYPE = '01' then (case when A.DETAIL_DIST = '08' then CAST( A.SUBJECT_NAME ) else 0 end) when A.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' then (case when A.DETAIL_DIST = '29' then CAST( A.SUBJECT_NAME ) else 0 end) else 0 end) NET_UNIT_VALUE,
CASE WHEN A.DETAIL_DIST = '17' THEN CAST(A.SUBJECT_NAME) ELSE 0 END AS TAOTALNETVALUE, CASE WHEN A.DETAIL_DIST = '33' THEN CAST(A.SUBJECT_NAME) ELSE 0 END AS SEVENDAYRATE FROM ( SELECT BVD.VAL_DATE AS VAL_DATE,BVD.COST AS COST,BVD.DETAIL_DIST AS DETAIL_DIST,BVD.SUBJECT_NO,BVD.SUBJECT_NAME, BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS FINPROD_ID,BB.BOOKSET_NAME AS FINPROD_NAME ,BB.ACCT_MODE PROFIT_TYPE,BVD.BAL_FLAG,BVD.MARKET_VALUE AS MARKET_VALUE
FROM BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA BVD JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BB ON BVD.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID
WHERE 1=1
AND BVD.VAL_DATE >= #{valDateBegin,jdbcType=DATE}
AND BVD.VAL_DATE <= #{valDateEnd,jdbcType=DATE}
AND BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
AND BVD.DETAIL_DIST IN ('01','02','07','08','17','28','29','33') ) A ) B GROUP BY B.VAL_DATE,B.FINPROD_ID,B.FINPROD_NAME
